title: Jorgensen 2001: sex-specific regressions of coronal-plane centroid distance ("moment-arm") on anthropometry, L3-L5

imaging.modality: MRI 1.5 T Philips GyroScan, spin echo T1 (TR 240, TE 12)
imaging.plane: transverse slices perpendicular to the table (scanner axial), through approximate centres of vertebral bodies T8-S1
imaging.posture_detail: supine, knees extended, hands across abdomen

quantity.name: regression
quantity.definition: regression equation(s) predicting a muscle-geometry quantity from anthropometry

source.authors: Jorgensen MJ, Marras WS, Granata KP, Wiand JW
source.sample: 30 healthy subjects (20 F, 10 M); young healthy volunteers, no activity-limiting back pain

protocol.summary: Significant linear regressions (best 3-4 per muscle/side/sex/level) of MRI centroid distances (cm) on external anthropometry.
how_to_simulate: Evaluate the regression equation with the subject anthropometry (units as given in data).
Compare the model quantity (as defined for the predicted variable) with the predicted value +/- SE of prediction.
protocol.notes: ERRATUM applied: TDICH, TWICH, TDXPH, TWXPH, TCIRH are divided by height in cm (cm/cm), not m. HT is not defined in Table 2; cm inferred. Equations predict cm. Sagittal equations predict signed values (posterior negative).
